top_findings.title: Hermes Agent Native WeChat Support
top_findings.text:

top_findings.title: AG-UI Protocol for AI Agent-Frontend Communication
top_findings.text:
AI agents can finally talk to your frontend!

The AG-UI Protocol bridges the critical gap between AI agents and frontend apps, making human-agent collaboration seamless.

MCP: Agents to tools
A2A:  Agents to agents
AG-UI: Agents to users

100% open-source. https://t.co/OImTiNB0AM
